descriptors.name: column-id
descriptors.description: Target column for ALL created tasks (one column per call).
descriptors.helpText: Target column for ALL created tasks (one column per call).

descriptors.name: idempotency-key
descriptors.description: Optional idempotency key: retrying with the same key and arguments within 24h returns the original result instead of creating duplicates. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with CONFLICT.
descriptors.helpText: Optional idempotency key: retrying with the same key and arguments within 24h returns the original result instead of creating duplicates. Reusing a key with different arguments fails with CONFLICT.

descriptors.name: tasks-json
descriptors.helpText: Tasks to create, in order (max 50). (JSON array; or --tasks-file to read from a file)

descriptors.name: tasks-file
descriptors.helpText: Read tasks as JSON from a file ("-" = stdin; alternative to --tasks-json)
